summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added the "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection to docs/source/data.rst, and wrote tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was committed and no tests or repository code were run, so the tests are unverified. Lines were checked for the 120-column limit with awk; black and flake8 were not run. Choices: quoted "str | None" annotation and builtin list return to avoid a typing import on 3.9; missing image/label keys are skipped rather than required; a JSON decode error is re-raised as ValueError naming the file.
